verses.original: Καταβάντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί
verses.transliteration: Katabantos de autou apo tou orous ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi
verses.literal: When Jesus came down from the mountain large crowds followed Him
verses.literalPt: Quando Jesus desceu do monte, acompanharam-no grandes multidões.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων Κύριε ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι
verses.transliteration: kai idou lepros proselthōn prosekynei autō legōn Kyrie ean thelēs dynasai me katharisai
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . a leper came and knelt before Him saying Lord if You are willing You can make me clean . . .
verses.literalPt: Aproximando-se um leproso, adorava-o, dizendo: Senhor, se quiseres, bem podes tornar-me limpo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ λέγων Θέλω καθαρίσθητι καὶ εὐθέως ἐκαθαρίσθη αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα
verses.transliteration: Kai ekteinas tēn cheira hēpsato autou legōn Thelō katharisthēti kai eutheōs ekatharisthē autou hē lepra
verses.literal: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man I am willing He said Be clean And immediately his leprosy was cleansed
verses.literalPt: Jesus, estendendo a mão, tocou-o, dizendo: Quero; fica limpo. No mesmo instante, ficou limpa a sua lepra.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὅρα μηδενὶ εἴπῃς ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō ho Iēsous Hora mēdeni eipēs alla hypage seauton deixon tō hierei kai prosenenkon to dōron ho prosetaxen Mōusēs eis martyrion autois
verses.literal: Then Jesus instructed him See that you don’t tell anyone . . . But go show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses as a testimony to them
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Olha, não o digas a alguém, mas vai mostrar-te ao sacerdote e fazer a oferta que Moisés ordenou, para lhes servir de testemunho.

verses.original: Εἰσελθόντος δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἑκατόνταρχος παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Eiselthontos de autou eis Kapharnaoum prosēlthen autō hekatontarchos parakalōn auton
verses.literal: When Jesus had entered . . . Capernaum a centurion came and pleaded with Him
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jesus entrado em Cafarnaum, chegou-se a ele um centurião e rogou-lhe:

verses.original: καὶ λέγων Κύριε ὁ παῖς μου βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος
verses.transliteration: kai legōn Kyrie ho pais mou beblētai en tē oikia paralytikos deinōs basanizomenos
verses.literal: Lord my servant lies at home paralyzed and in terrible agony
verses.literalPt: Senhor, o meu criado jaz em casa paralítico, padecendo horrivelmente.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autō Egō elthōn therapeusō auton
verses.literal: I will go and heal him Jesus replied
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe ele: Eu irei curá-lo.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος ἔφη Κύριε οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς ἵνα μου ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην εἰσέλθῃς ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ καὶ ἰαθήσεται ὁ παῖς μου
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho hekatontarchos ephē Kyrie ouk eimi hikanos hina mou hypo tēn stegēn eiselthēs alla monon eipe logō kai iathēsetai ho pais mou
verses.literal: The centurion answered . . . Lord I am not worthy to have You come under my roof But just say the word and my servant will be healed
verses.literalPt: Mas o centurião respondeu: Senhor, não sou digno de que entres em minha casa; porém dize somente uma palavra, e o meu criado há de sarar.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν ἔχων ὑπ’ ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας καὶ λέγω τούτῳ Πορεύθητι καὶ πορεύεται καὶ ἄλλῳ Ἔρχου καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου Ποίησον τοῦτο καὶ ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai gar egō anthrōpos eimi hypo exousian echōn hyp’ emauton stratiōtas kai legō toutō Poreuthēti kai poreuetai kai allō Erchou kai erchetai kai tō doulō mou Poiēson touto kai poiei
verses.literal: For I myself am a man under authority with soldiers under me I tell one to go and he goes and another to come and he comes I tell my servant to do something and he does it
verses.literalPt: Pois também eu sou homem sujeito à autoridade, e tenho soldados às minhas ordens, e digo a um: Vai ali, e ele vai; a outro: Vem cá, e ele vem; e ao meu servo: Faze isto, e ele o faz.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν παρ’ οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον
verses.transliteration: Akousas de ho Iēsous ethaumasen kai eipen tois akolouthousin Amēn legō hymin par’ oudeni tosautēn pistin en tō Israēl heuron
verses.literal: When Jesus heard this He marveled and said to those following Him Truly I tell you I have not found anyone . . . . . . in Israel with such great faith
verses.literalPt: Jesus, ouvindo isso, admirou-se e disse aos que o acompanhavam: Em verdade vos afirmo que nem mesmo em Israel achei tamanha fé.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin hoti polloi apo anatolōn kai dysmōn hēxousin kai anaklithēsontai meta Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos que muitos virão do Oriente e do Ocidente e hão de sentar-se com Abraão, Isaque e Jacó no reino dos céus;

verses.original: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: hoi de huioi tēs basileias ekblēthēsontai eis to skotos to exōteron ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth
verses.literalPt: mas os filhos do reino serão lançados nas trevas exteriores; ali haverá o choro e o ranger de dentes.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ Ὕπαγε ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι καὶ ἰάθη ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen ho Iēsous tō hekatontarchē Hypage hōs episteusas genēthētō soi kai iathē ho pais autou en tē hōra ekeinē
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to the centurion Go As you have believed so will it be done for you And his servant was healed at that very hour
verses.literalPt: Disse Jesus ao centurião: Vai-te, e, como creste, assim te seja feito. Naquela mesma hora, sarou o criado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Πέτρου εἶδεν τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτοῦ βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν
verses.transliteration: Kai elthōn ho Iēsous eis tēn oikian Petrou eiden tēn pentheran autou beblēmenēn kai pyressousan
verses.literal: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever
verses.literalPt: Tendo entrado Jesus na casa de Pedro, viu que a sogra deste estava de cama e com febre;

verses.original: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hēpsato tēs cheiros autēs kai aphēken autēn ho pyretos kai ēgerthē kai diēkonei autō
verses.literal: So He touched her hand and the fever left her and she got up and began to serve Him
verses.literalPt: e, tocando-lhe a mão, a febre a deixou. Ela se levantou e o servia.

verses.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζομένους πολλούς καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ καὶ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ἐθεράπευσεν
verses.transliteration: Opsias de genomenēs prosēnenkan autō daimonizomenous pollous kai exebalen ta pneumata logō kai pantas tous kakōs echontas etherapeusen
verses.literal: When evening came many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick
verses.literalPt: À tarde, trouxeram-lhe muitos endemoninhados; ele, com a sua palavra, expeliu os espíritos e curou todos os doentes;

verses.original: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Αὐτὸς τὰς ἀσθενείας ἡμῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ τὰς νόσους ἐβάστασεν
verses.transliteration: hopōs plērōthē to rhēthen dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos Autos tas astheneias hēmōn elaben kai tas nosous ebastasen
verses.literal: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah He took up . . . our infirmities and carried our diseases
verses.literalPt: para se cumprir o que foi dito pelo profeta Isaías: Ele mesmo tomou as nossas enfermidades e carregou com as nossas doenças.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς πολλοὺς ὄχλον περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ho Iēsous pollous ochlon peri auton ekeleusen apelthein eis to peran
verses.literal: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea
verses.literalPt: Vendo Jesus uma multidão ao redor de si, mandou passar para a outra margem do lago.

verses.original: Καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς γραμματεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai proselthōn heis grammateus eipen autō Didaskale akolouthēsō soi hopou ean aperchē
verses.literal: And one of the scribes came to Him and said Teacher I will follow You wherever You go
verses.literalPt: Chegou um escriba e disse-lhe: Mestre, seguir-te-ei para onde quer que fores.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις ὁ δὲ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autō ho Iēsous Hai alōpekes phōleous echousin kai ta peteina tou ouranou kataskēnōseis ho de Huios tou anthrōpou ouk echei pou tēn kephalēn klinē
verses.literal: Jesus replied - Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: As raposas têm covis, e as aves do céu, pousos; mas o Filho do Homem não tem onde reclinar a cabeça.

verses.original: Ἕτερος δὲ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου
verses.transliteration: Heteros de tōn mathētōn autou eipen autō Kyrie epitrepson moi prōton apelthein kai thapsai ton patera mou
verses.literal: Another of His disciples requested Lord first let me go and bury my father
verses.literalPt: Um outro discípulo disse-lhe: Senhor, deixa-me ir primeiro enterrar meu pai.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous legei autō Akolouthei moi kai aphes tous nekrous thapsai tous heautōn nekrous
verses.literal: But Jesus told him Follow Me and let the dead bury their own dead
verses.literalPt: Porém Jesus respondeu-lhe: Segue-me e deixa que os mortos enterrem os seus mortos.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμβάντι αὐτῷ εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai embanti autō eis to ploion ēkolouthēsan autō hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: When He got into . . . the boat His disciples followed Him
verses.literalPt: Entrando ele na barca, seus discípulos acompanharam-no.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκάθευδεν
verses.transliteration: kai idou seismos megas egeneto en tē thalassē hōste to ploion kalyptesthai hypo tōn kymatōn autos de ekatheuden
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . a violent storm came up on the sea so that the boat was engulfed by the waves But Jesus was sleeping
verses.literalPt: Eis que se levantou no mar tão grande tempestade, que as ondas cobriam a barca; mas Jesus dormia.

verses.original: καὶ προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε σῶσον ἀπολλύμεθα
verses.transliteration: kai proselthontes ēgeiran auton legontes Kyrie sōson apollymetha
verses.literal: The disciples went and woke Him saying Lord save us We are perishing
verses.literalPt: Os discípulos, aproximando-se, acordaram-no, dizendo: Salva-nos, Senhor, que perecemos.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί δειλοί ἐστε ὀλιγόπιστοι τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois Ti deiloi este oligopistoi tote egertheis epetimēsen tois anemois kai tē thalassē kai egeneto galēnē megalē
verses.literal: You of little faith Jesus replied . . . why are you so afraid Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea and it was perfectly calm
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes disse: Por que temeis, homens de pouca fé? Então, erguendo-se, repreendeu os ventos e o mar; e fez-se grande bonança.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες Ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα αὐτῷ ὑπακούουσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de anthrōpoi ethaumasan legontes Potapos estin houtos hoti kai hoi anemoi kai hē thalassa autō hypakouousin
verses.literal: The men were amazed and asked What kind of man is this Even the winds and the sea obey Him
verses.literalPt: Todos se maravilharam, dizendo: Que homem é este que até os ventos e o mar lhe obedecem?

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἐξερχόμενοι χαλεποὶ λίαν ὥστε μὴ ἰσχύειν τινὰ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐκείνης
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontos autou eis to peran eis tēn chōran tōn Gadarēnōn hypēntēsan autō dyo daimonizomenoi ek tōn mnēmeiōn exerchomenoi chalepoi lian hōste mē ischyein tina parelthein dia tēs hodou ekeinēs
verses.literal: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes He was met by . . . two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs They were so violent that no one could pass . . . that way
verses.literalPt: Tendo ele chegado à outra banda, à terra dos gadarenos, dois endemoninhados, em extremo furiosos, de modo que ninguém podia passar por aquele caminho, saindo dos túmulos, vieram-lhe ao encontro.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἦλθες ὧδε πρὸ καιροῦ βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai idou ekraxan legontes Ti hēmin kai soi Huie tou Theou ēlthes hōde pro kairou basanisai hēmas
verses.literal: What do You want with us Son of God - they shouted Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time
verses.literalPt: Eles gritaram: Que temos nós contigo, Filho de Deus? Vieste aqui atormentar-nos antes do tempo?

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων πολλῶν βοσκομένη
verses.transliteration: Ēn de makran ap’ autōn agelē choirōn pollōn boskomenē
verses.literal: In the distance . . . . . . a large herd of pigs was feeding
verses.literalPt: Ora, a alguma distância deles pastava uma grande manada de porcos.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων
verses.transliteration: hoi de daimones parekaloun auton legontes Ei ekballeis hēmas aposteilon hēmas eis tēn agelēn tōn choirōn
verses.literal: So the demons begged Jesus If You drive us out . . . send us . . . into the herd of pigs
verses.literalPt: Os demônios rogavam-lhe: Se nos expeles, envia-nos para a manada de porcos.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥρμησεν πᾶσα ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Hypagete hoi de exelthontes apēlthon eis tous choirous kai idou hōrmēsen pasa hē agelē kata tou krēmnou eis tēn thalassan kai apethanon en tois hydasin
verses.literal: Go He told them So they came out and went into the pigs and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Ide. Tendo eles saído, passaram para os porcos; toda a manada precipitou-se pelo declive no mar, e ali se afogaram.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων
verses.transliteration: Hoi de boskontes ephygon kai apelthontes eis tēn polin apēngeilan panta kai ta tōn daimonizomenōn
verses.literal: Those tending the pigs ran off . . . . . . into the town and reported all this including the account of the demon-possessed men
verses.literalPt: Os pastores fugiram, foram à cidade, contaram todas essas coisas e o que tinha acontecido aos endemoninhados.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai idou pasa hē polis exēlthen eis hypantēsin tō Iēsou kai idontes auton parekalesan hopōs metabē apo tōn horiōn autōn
verses.literal: Then . . . the whole town went out to meet Jesus And when they saw Him they begged Him to leave . . . their region
verses.literalPt: Então, a cidade toda saiu ao encontro de Jesus; e, ao verem-no, rogaram-lhe que se retirasse daqueles termos.
